notes: Model routing for Claude runtimes lives in 'tiers'; routing for Codex runtimes / codex-exec cross-dispatch lives in 'codex_tiers' (see references/model-routing-codex.md); Gemini in 'gemini_tiers' (references/model-routing-gemini.md); Grok in 'grok_tiers' (references/model-routing-grok.md). Other runtimes map the abstract tiers onto their own lineup — see 'Portability & Model Routing' in SKILL.md.
Claude reviews run strictly on Opus 5 and Fable 5.1; Sonnet 5 is restricted to the very low end (cheap tier: triage, mechanical work, patch application).
limits.max_concurrent_agents caps SIMULTANEOUS dispatches, not the total. A large PR may select 12 agents; launch them in waves of <= max_concurrent_agents and queue the rest.
fallback: null means: on refusal/failure, record the dimension as 'no coverage — degraded' in the report and continue. Never abort the run.

cheap.notes: Very low end: triage, mechanical work, patch application, trivial passes. Effort low only. Substantive reviews never run on Sonnet.

standard.notes: Core review workhorse for all standard dimensions (logic, silent failure, tests, performance, types, style, comments). Full Opus-class depth with zero classifier-refusal risk.

strong.notes: Coordinator, adjudication, and universal fallback. Safe and reliable for orchestrating the run.

deep.notes: Risk-surface review (security, migrations) and architectural deep dives. Fable 5.1 refuses fewer legitimate checks than 5.0, but when safety classifiers trigger on security-adjacent content, fallback is Opus 5. Mandatory 30-day retention, no ZDR. Expensive.

codex_tiers.notes: Always pass -m and model_reasoning_effort explicitly (never inherit ~/.codex/config.toml defaults). Review leaves run '-s read-only'. Fallbacks stay within the 5.6 and 6.x Astra lineup (astra <-> sol <-> terra); never route to gpt-5.5 or older. Verify IDs against ~/.codex/models_cache.json after any model-generation bump.

cheap.notes: Triage, mechanical checks, patch application. 'medium' for larger shards. Cheapest tier; 'ultra' accepted but may clamp to max.

standard.notes: Most review dimensions; effort up to 'high'. Solid everyday capability at reasonable cost.

strong.notes: Adjudication-grade review and universal fallback; effort up to 'xhigh'. Also the vision tier (attach images with -i) — GPT vision outperforms Claude on screenshot/UI review. When quota allows, gpt-6-astra (effort: medium/high) can also serve as strong tier.

deep.notes: Risk-surface review (security, migrations). Flagship model with reasoning levels low..max. Fallback: gpt-5.6-sol (effort: max).

gemini_tiers.notes: Model routing for Gemini runtimes (Gemini CLI, Antigravity). Maps abstract tiers to Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro (3.8 Pro is not yet available).

cheap.notes: Triage, mechanical checks, patch application with low reasoning.

standard.notes: Most review dimensions (logic, silent failure, style, comment, tests) with high reasoning.

strong.notes: Coordinator, adjudication, universal fallback (highest-tier Pro model available).

deep.notes: Risk-surface review (security, migrations) with maximum reasoning depth.

grok_tiers.notes: Model routing for xAI / Grok runtimes. Anchored on Grok 4.6 (with Grok 4.7 upcoming upon release).

cheap.notes: Triage, mechanical checks, patch application with minimal reasoning.

deep.notes: Risk-surface review (security, migrations) with maximum reasoning depth. Upgrade to grok-4.7 upon release.
